origin.description: get_extent() calculates the display width for each string in a character vector.
origin.value: An integer vector of display widths, one per string.

translation.description: get_extent() calculates the display width for each string in a character vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A character vector. A string returns one width. A list returns one width per string. None is a missing string.

translation.details: ANSI CSI and OSC sequences are not counted. A missing string has width 2, the width of the letters NA. A tab has width 0.
translation.value: An int for one string, or a list of ints.
